text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience helping businesses organize, clean, and present data in a way that is accurate, useful, and easy to work with. I’d be glad to help with your WooCommerce category icon task, especially since it involves careful Excel handling, data import accuracy, and attention to how content appears across your site.

My background includes SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard work, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’m comfortable working independently, following a structured process, and checking details carefully before anything goes live. For a task like this, I would first review the Excel sheet, confirm the icon links are usable, and organize the data so each icon can be matched to the correct WooCommerce category. Then I would make sure the icons are suitable for the intended display, import them cleanly, and verify that they appear correctly and consistently.

I’ve built data solutions that required both accuracy and clear presentation. For example, on the Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports and reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. I also completed a Dental clinic expansion model for Sunrise Dental Partners, building a three-site Excel model with best, base, and worst cases, where the chosen site was projected to pay back in 14 months. Those projects reflect the kind of structured thinking and detail-focused work I bring to data tasks.

For your project, I would also test the icons across different devices and browsers, troubleshoot any issues that come up during import or display, and provide a clear summary report at the end with any useful recommendations for future maintenance. I understand the importance of making sure the final result not only works technically but also fits the site’s design and user experience.

Would you like me to treat the Excel sheet as the source of truth and work from the icon links exactly as provided, or should I flag any broken or missing links for you first?
